purpose: Teach: 尺度/原題/考案/多種/年版/義務づけ/失格/事業主

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪の評価尺度を統一しております
lines.en: We've standardized our evaluation criteria for all crime classifications.
lines.style: Steady, official tone. Even pace. No hurry. The voice of someone explaining procedure without apologizing for it. Slight formality in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、事件原題の整理、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for organizing the original case files so carefully.
lines.style: Attentive, genuine appreciation underneath the courtesy. Slight lean forward. Warm but respectful. Not performed gratitude — earned.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新しい捜査法を考案いたしました
lines.en: We've developed a new investigative method we'd like to implement.
lines.style: Clear, methodical delivery. Slight pride in the innovation without boasting. Even tempo. The voice of someone presenting competent work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察は多種の専門官を抱えておられますね
lines.en: Yes. The police department has quite a range of specialists, doesn't it.
lines.style: Observant, genuine respect. Not flattery — noticing something real. Warm undertone. Slight pause before the tag question, like he's thinking it through.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、年版の白書を発行いたしております
lines.en: We publish an annual white paper on our findings and procedures.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. Light emphasis on 'annual' — routine but significant. No defensiveness. The tone of institutional continuity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の通報義務づけ、警察、徹底ですね
lines.en: Yes. It's reassuring how thoroughly the police follow up on citizen reports.
lines.style: Sincere, not diplomatic. Slight warmth underneath the formality. He means this. Gentle downward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不適格者を失格対象としております
lines.en: We remove officers from duty if they're found to be unsuitable for the role.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Clean delivery of a serious standard. No equivocation. The voice of someone protecting something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害事業主の支援、警察、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. It's good to know the police support business owners who've been affected by crime.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Slight softening on 'support' — this matters to him. Close range, like speaking to someone he trusts. Sincere.
